boundary_label: SYNTHETIC ENGINEERING-EVENT CLASSIFICATION — NOT AAMI-SVF OR CLINICAL VALIDATION
digest_authority: reports/model_v2/v2_fl_005/federation_run.json (frozen). Any state whose recomputed digest differs aborts the evaluation (no substitution).
eligibility: a window is evaluated iff trainable per federated.virtual_client_source_v1.is_trainable (VALID, 2500 samples, no missing slots, finite); DEGRADED/UNUSABLE windows are excluded exactly as in training

holdout.mirrors: eight frozen site conditions (faults, context, coverage, heart-rate convention); events re-drawn

labels: WEARABLE_SIM_EVENT_WINDOW_V1 positive iff a scheduled synthetic event lies in [t-10 s, t]
live_linked_candidate: evaluated separately, on the SAME frozen holdout, only if its own run digest/candidate digest are recorded; never merged with the canonical rows

metric_definitions.BCE: mean unweighted binary cross-entropy from logits
metric_definitions.participant_macro_F1: mean of per-participant F1 over participants with defined F1; undefined count reported

model.architecture: MODEL_V2_FINAL parameters/state layout as used by FL (federated.model_v2_fl)

non_clinical_boundary: Synthetic engineering-event classification on simulated wearable windows. Not AAMI-SVF, not a diagnosis, not a clinical or device validation, not an efficacy claim for MODEL_V2_FINAL.
outcome_policy: all outcomes are reported as measured, including poor ones
preprocessing: per-window z-score exactly as the training dataset builder (normalize_windows)
reproduce: python -m scripts.freeze_synth_fl_eval_protocol  # regenerates this protocol + manifest byte-identically
separation_rules: no holdout participant_id equals a training participant_id
no holdout session_id equals a training session_id
no holdout seed equals a training seed
no holdout window input digest equals any training window input digest
holdout windows never enter any LocalTrainingBuffer or optimizer step
target: synthetic engineering event within the preceding 10 s of a QUALITY_V1-VALID 2500-sample window (label provider SyntheticEventLabelProvider)

training_cohort.local: AdamW lr 0.001 wd 0.0001 batch 64, 1 epoch, pos_weight 1.7157717177396683

uncertainty.status: NOMINAL ONLY — 8 clusters; interval is unstable and is not a significance claim

undefined_policy: a metric whose denominator is zero or whose classes are missing is reported as null with an explicit reason (UNDEFINED); never replaced by 0
views: secondary: training-buffer windows (labelled training-data metrics, not generalisation)
